spans.s:
फे(ण)न m. (-नः)
 1. Froth, foam.
 2. Cuttle-fish-bone, supposed to be the
indurated foam of the sea.
 3. Vapour.
 E. स्फायी to swell, नक् Unādi
aff., deriv. irr.

फे(ण)नक m. (-कः) Cuttle-fish-bone.
 f. (-का)
 1. Rice, ground and boiled
with water.
 2. The soap berry.
 E. फेन froth, and कन् aff.
